inbox.title: Customer Support
inbox.confirmClose: Are you sure you want to close this chat session? You will need to scan the QR code again to reconnect.
inbox.connectDescription: Scan the QR code provided in your room to start requesting support or chatting.
inbox.manualDescription: Enter the token printed below the QR code or provided by the reception.
inbox.helpStep1: Find the QR code placed in your room (usually on the desk or room guide).
inbox.helpStep2: Press the "Scan QR Code" button above and grant camera access.
inbox.helpStep3: After connecting, you can message to request room cleaning, order food, or ask for information.
inbox.scanDescription: Point your camera at the QR code in your room
inbox.scanError: QR scan error. Please try again.
